mainEntity.name: Is AEO a replacement for traditional SEO, or does it work alongside it for pest control marketing?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO is not a replacement but an evolution and complement to traditional SEO. While traditional SEO focuses on improving rankings through keywords, backlinks, and technical optimization, AEO specifically targets the growing trend of answer engine results, such as featured snippets, knowledge panels, and voice search answers. It leverages SEO best practices but emphasizes content structure and direct answers. For a pest control business, integrating AEO with your existing SEO strategy will provide a more comprehensive approach to online visibility, capturing both traditional search results and direct answers.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO complements traditional SEO by focusing on direct answers for search engines and voice assistants, leveraging SEO best practices to capture featured snippets and knowledge panels.
